sequential_dependency.intermediate: The per-route swept-footprint sizes and ordered collision lists, plus the shortest target-contacting route selected by (footprint size, collision count, instruction color).
sequential_dependency.step_a: Trace every header instruction from the color-8 square through its input-derived target and complete post-turn bounce route.
sequential_dependency.step_b: After painting the canonical trail, recolor the original target rectangle of the selected shortest route to color 9.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected target is not determined by source order, raw rectangle size, or collision count alone; B needs the complete route footprints computed by A.
